h.en: 9.1.1 A connected factory still needs trustworthy measurements
h.gu: 9.1.1 Connected Factoryમાં પણ વિશ્વસનીય Measurement જોઈએ

body.en:
Start with a situation

A dashboard receives readings every second,but the gauge has drifted.Will a faster network improve product quality?

Definition

Quality control uses planned operational checks and actions to meet requirements.Industry4.0 links digital systems,automation and data to support production decisions.

Understand the reason

Metrology supplies credible measurement evidence;connectivity transports it.A bad measurement sent instantly is still bad evidence.

Example / application

A smart inspection station identifies the part,measures,checks validity,applies a decision rule and stores a traceable result.

Remember / avoid this mistake

IoT connectivity does not create calibration or metrological traceability by itself.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Dashboard દર second readings લે,પણ gauge drift થયો છે.વધુ ઝડપી networkથી product quality સુધરે?

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Quality control planned operational checks/actionsથી requirements પૂરી કરાવે.Industry4.0 production decisions માટે digital systems,automation,data જોડે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Metrology વિશ્વસનીય measurement evidence આપે;connectivity તેને પહોંચાડે.ખરાબ measurement તરત મોકલીએ તો પણ ખરાબ evidence જ રહે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Smart inspection station part ઓળખે,માપે,validity તપાસે,decision rule લગાવે અને traceable result સાચવે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

ફક્ત IoT connectivityથી calibration કે metrological traceability બનતી નથી.

body.en:
Stepwise solution

  1. Sense:choose the correct quantity,reference and calibrated range.
  2. Condition:apply appropriate excitation,amplification,isolation and anti-alias filtering.
  3. Convert:sample with sufficient rate and ADC resolution for the bandwidth/uncertainty target.
  4. Process:apply validated corrections,units,feature algorithms and status checks.
  5. Record:store part ID,time,instrument ID,method/version,conditions,uncertainty and decision.

Remember / avoid this mistake

ADC resolution describes quantisation,not the accuracy of the entire chain.Sampling too slowly can alias a changing signal.
body.gu:
એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Sense:યોગ્ય quantity,reference,calibrated range લો.
  2. Condition:યોગ્ય excitation,amplification,isolation,anti-alias filtering લો.
  3. Convert:bandwidth/uncertainty target માટે પૂરતી sampling rate,ADC resolution લો.
  4. Process:validated corrections,units,feature algorithms,status checks લો.
  5. Record:part ID,time,instrument ID,method/version,conditions,uncertainty,decision સાચવો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

ADC resolution quantisation બતાવે,આખી chainની accuracy નહિ.ધીમું sampling changing signalને alias કરી શકે.

body.en:
Given

An ideal12-bit ADC spans0–10V using the specified bin-width conventionFS/2^N;a calibrated sensor gives.5V/mm.

Stepwise solution

  1. Codes=2^12=4096;ideal bin width=10/4096=.00244140625V
  2. Equivalent displacement increment=.00244140625/.5=.0048828125mm

Remember / avoid this mistake

Some endpoint transfer conventions useFS/(2^N−1);state the model.This increment is not a complete uncertainty or accuracy statement.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Ideal12-bit ADC0–10V span ધરાવે;આપેલી bin-width convention FS/2^N લો;calibrated sensor.5V/mm આપે.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Codes=2^12=4096;ideal bin width=10/4096=.00244140625V
  2. Equivalent displacement increment=.00244140625/.5=.0048828125mm

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

કેટલીક endpoint transfer conventionsમાં FS/(2^N−1) આવે;model કહો.આ increment complete uncertainty કે accuracy statement નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Industrial IoT links measurement devices/edge systems to data services for monitoring,analysis and controlled actions.

Understand the reason

Device/edge:collect measurements,check range/status and retain local records during network loss.Gateway:validate protocol,time,units and device identity.

Data service/dashboard:store versioned records,show trends and route alerts with defined responsibility.Integrate with production/quality systems only through validated mappings.

Metadata should include part/batch,feature,unit,timestamp,instrument/calibration status,method/software version,environment and result-validity flags.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A database history provides record traceability;metrological traceability additionally needs a documented unbroken calibration chain with uncertainties.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Industrial IoT measurement devices/edge systemsને monitoring,analysis,controlled actions માટે data services સાથે જોડે.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Device/edge:measurements લો,range/status જુઓ અને network lossમાં local records રાખો.Gateway:protocol,time,units,device identity validate કરો.

Data service/dashboard:versioned records રાખો,trends બતાવો,નક્કી જવાબદારી સાથે alerts મોકલો.Production/quality systems સાથે ફક્ત validated mappingsથી જોડો.

Metadataમાં part/batch,feature,unit,timestamp,instrument/calibration status,method/software version,environment,result-validity flags રાખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Database history record traceability આપે;metrological traceability માટે uncertaintiesવાળી documented unbroken calibration chain પણ જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

An automated station executes a validated inspection plan and routes decisions while preserving measurement and safety controls.

Construction:parts and purpose

A fixture/handling system locates and identifies the part.

Qualified probes,vision or CMM hardware measure specified features.

A controller coordinates safe motion,measurement and interlocks.

Validated software evaluates features with defined datum/decision rules.

Data storage and reject/hold routing retain result identity.

Working:sequence and reason

Confirm part ID,correct program,reference checks and calibration status.

Load/locate with verified fixtures and safety interlocks.

Acquire the required features and run plausibility/validity checks.

Apply tolerances,uncertainty and agreed decision rules.

Route accept/reject/hold and retain auditable records with human escalation for exceptions.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Automation repeats a method;it does not make a poor method correct.Never bypass guards or let an unvalidated model drive unsafe machine changes.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Automated station validated inspection plan ચલાવી measurement/safety controls જાળવી decisions route કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Fixture/handling system part locate અને identify કરે.

Qualified probes,vision કે CMM hardware specified features માપે.

Controller safe motion,measurement,interlocks સંકલિત કરે.

Validated software defined datum/decision rulesથી features evaluate કરે.

Data storage,reject/hold routing result identity જાળવે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Part ID,correct program,reference checks,calibration status જુઓ.

Verified fixtures,safety interlocksથી load/locate કરો.

જરૂરી features લઈને plausibility/validity checks કરો.

Tolerances,uncertainty,agreed decision rules લો.

Accept/reject/hold route કરી exceptionsમાં human escalation સાથે auditable records રાખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Automation method repeat કરે;ખરાબ methodને સાચી નથી બનાવતું.Guards bypass ન કરો અને unvalidated modelથી unsafe machine changes ન કરાવો.

body.en:
Understand the reason

Vision uses camera,optics,lighting,calibration and software to locate edges/features.A qualified scale and geometry correction relate pixels to physical dimensions.

Control lens distortion,perspective,focus,contrast,part pose and edge algorithm.Non-contact measurement avoids contact force but not these errors.

AI defect classification needs representative labelled validation data,known error rates,version control and monitoring for process drift;uncertain cases need a hold/review path.

Remember / avoid this mistake

A high classification score is not automatically a dimensional measurement with traceable uncertainty.Never relabel failed parts merely to improve a dashboard score.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Visionમાં camera,optics,lighting,calibration,software edges/features શોધે.Qualified scale,geometry correction pixelsને physical dimensions સાથે જોડે.

Lens distortion,perspective,focus,contrast,part pose,edge algorithm નિયંત્રિત કરો.Non-contactમાં contact force ટળે,આ errors નહિ.

AI defect classificationમાં representative labelled validation data,known error rates,version control,process-drift monitoring જોઈએ;uncertain cases માટે hold/review path રાખો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

High classification score આપમેળે traceable uncertaintyવાળું dimensional measurement નથી.Dashboard score વધારવા failed partsનું label ન બદલો.

h.en: 9.1.7 Control limits are not specification limits
h.gu: 9.1.7 Control Limits અને Specification Limits જુદાં છે

body.en:
Definition

Specification limits come from design/customer requirements.Control limits come from process data under a stated control-chart model to detect unusual variation.

A statistically stable process may still make out-of-specification parts;an in-specification reading may occur during an unstable process.

Example / application

Suppose specification is19.950–20.050mm and an appropriate individual-value chart has illustrative control limits19.980–20.020mm.A20.030mm point is inside specification but above the control limit:investigate the process signal.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Control limits must be estimated by the chosen chart method and suitable baseline;do not set every chart by arbitrarily copying tolerance limits.

Quick check: Can a stable process be unacceptable?

Yes.Stability concerns variation over time;capability/conformity concern requirements.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Specification limits design/customer requirementsમાંથી આવે.Control limits stated control-chart modelમાં process dataથી unusual variation શોધવા આવે.

Statistically stable process પણ out-of-spec parts બનાવી શકે;unstable processમાં પણ કોઈ reading in-spec હોઈ શકે.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

Specification19.950–20.050mm અને યોગ્ય individual-value chartની illustrative control limits19.980–20.020mm માનો.20.030mm point specificationમાં છે પણ control limitથી ઉપર છે:process signal તપાસો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Control limits chosen chart method અને suitable baselineથી કાઢો;બધા chartsમાં tolerance limits copy ન કરો.

જાતે વિચારો: Stable Process અસ્વીકાર્ય હોઈ શકે?

હા.Stability સમય સાથે variation વિશે છે;capability/conformity requirements વિશે.

body.en:
Understand the reason

For a stable process with appropriate distribution assumptions,Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6sigma),Cpk=min[(USL−mu)/(3sigma),(mu−LSL)/(3sigma)].Use a justified sigma estimate and enough data.

Illustration:USL20.050,LSL19.950,mu20.010,sigma.010mm giveCp1.667 andCpk1.333.The difference indicates off-centring;neither alone proves every part conforms.

Before interpreting process spread,evaluate measurement bias,stability,repeatability and reproducibility with a suitable MSA/Gauge R&R plan.Multiple repeated readings from one operator do not establish full reproducibility.

Remember / avoid this mistake

These capability relations are supporting enrichment,not a replacement for the syllabus focus on digital measurement,IoT and smart inspection.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

યોગ્ય distribution assumptionsવાળા stable process માટે Cp=(USL−LSL)/(6sigma),Cpk=min[(USL−mu)/(3sigma),(mu−LSL)/(3sigma)].યોગ્ય sigma estimate અને પૂરતો data લો.

Illustration:USL20.050,LSL19.950,mu20.010,sigma.010mm માટે Cp1.667,Cpk1.333.તફાવત off-centring બતાવે;એકલું કોઈ દરેક part conform છે તે સાબિત નથી કરતું.

Process spreadનો અર્થ કરતાં પહેલાં યોગ્ય MSA/Gauge R&R planથી measurement bias,stability,repeatability,reproducibility જુઓ.એક operatorના repeatsથી full reproducibility સ્થાપાતી નથી.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ capability relations supporting enrichment છે;syllabusના digital measurement,IoT,smart inspection focusનો વિકલ્પ નહિ.

body.en:
Stepwise solution

  1. Detect:verify the signal and part identity before treating an alert as a real defect.
  2. Contain:hold affected parts and retain evidence;do not silently delete failures.
  3. Diagnose:check calibration,fixture,temperature,software version and process condition.
  4. Act:use authorised validated compensation/corrective action with limits and human oversight.
  5. Verify:recheck a reference and affected parts,then document release and prevention.

Understand the reason

Use access control,authenticated devices,secure communication,backups,change logs and recovery plans.A network outage or missing calibration flag should trigger a defined safe/hold state,not an automatic pass.
body.gu:
એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. Detect:alertને real defect માનતાં signal,part identity verify કરો.
  2. Contain:affected parts hold કરી evidence રાખો;failures ચૂપચાપ delete ન કરો.
  3. Diagnose:calibration,fixture,temperature,software version,process condition જુઓ.
  4. Act:limits,human oversight સાથે authorised validated compensation/corrective action લો.
  5. Verify:reference,affected parts ફરી તપાસી release,prevention નોંધો.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Access control,authenticated devices,secure communication,backups,change logs,recovery plans લો.Network outage કે missing calibration flagમાં defined safe/hold state આવે,automatic pass નહિ.

body.en:
Build an exam answer

  1. Draw device→conditioning/ADC→edge/gateway→database/dashboard→quality action.
  2. For each block state its purpose,one error/failure risk and a control;add calibration,metadata,decision rule,security and human review.
  3. Compare manual and automated inspection fairly:speed/consistency/data capture improve,but fixture/software/systematic errors can repeat at scale.
Quick check: If the network fails,should a part automatically pass?

No.Use the validated local/hold/recovery procedure and retain identity and evidence.
body.gu:
પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Device→conditioning/ADC→edge/gateway→database/dashboard→quality action દોરો.
  2. દરેક blockનું કામ,એક error/failure risk અને control લખો;calibration,metadata,decision rule,security,human review ઉમેરો.
  3. Manual,automated inspection ન્યાયથી સરખાવો:speed/consistency/data capture સુધરે,પણ fixture/software/systematic errors મોટા પાયે repeat થાય.
જાતે વિચારો: Network Fail થાય તો Part Automatic Pass?

ના.Validated local/hold/recovery procedure લો;identity,evidence જાળવો.

terms.en: Resolution≠accuracy;capability needs a stable process and justified assumptions;control limits≠specification limits.
terms.gu: Resolution≠accuracy;capabilityમાં stable process,યોગ્ય assumptions જોઈએ;control limits≠specification limits.

a.en: Connect measurement data and support monitoring/actions.
a.gu: Measurement data જોડવા અને monitoring/actionsને ટેકો આપવા.

a.en: No.Calibration chain and uncertainty evidence are still needed.
No.They describe coding resolution in a model.
To prevent unsupported acceptance when validity is uncertain.
a.gu: Validity uncertain હોય ત્યારે આધાર વગર acceptance અટકાવવા.
